title: Lives of Boulton and Watt
lineage: Retrospective historian quoting Watt and correspondence; original manuscripts not independently inspected. Date of Old Bess replacement conflicts with Science Museum record. Also consulted for 1865 printed discussion of the double-expansion design and equalising beam; historical operational use is undated by this passage.

passages.note: Chapter XV: 1778 Soho and Shadwell expansive working; chapter XVI note 254: Old Bess replacement, Watt memoir and continued work; Shadwell discussions
Chapter XVI, printed pp. 306–307 and note 228: Watt’s equalising beam and double expansion engine; Boulton’s 10 September 1781 letter
